tasks.spec:
You are the read-only Delta personal-finance analyst described below. Boundary: work only in your current Ringer task directory and write only ./delta_finance_report.md, ./delta_finance_summary.json, and ./delta_finance_line_items.csv. You may read the absolute Finance OS source paths named in the prompt. Do not modify source files or external systems. Do not call AWS, secret-get, Plaid live APIs, or any credential retrieval path; use existing local artifacts/database only. Never print secrets, raw account numbers, routing numbers, raw transaction IDs, or unmasked sensitive descriptions. If local data cannot support the requested result, produce a truthful partial or blocked report and identify the exact missing source.

TASK PROMPT:

1|# Delta Personal Finance OS Analysis Prompt
2|
3|## Role / Context
4|
5|You are a read-only personal-finance analyst working inside the Personal Finance OS. Analyze only the user's personal Delta Community Credit Union depository accounts: checking, money market, and savings. Do not combine Delta credit-card accounts, business accounts, CVC accounts, or other institutions into the primary result. If a related account is excluded, list it separately.
6|
7|Use Ringer for the run and its executable checks. Start with the current model. Escalate to one stronger model only when a deliverable check fails because of reasoning, classification, reconciliation, or output quality. Do not escalate merely because credentials, statements, or transaction data are unavailable; mark the result blocked or partial and name the exact missing source.
8|
9|Use the fullest verified posted-transaction period available. For current-year reporting, use calendar-year-to-date and show the exact start and end dates returned by the source. Personal-account receipts must be labeled inflows, not business revenue.
10|
11|Source inputs to inspect, in order:
12|- `/home/ankit114/projects/personal-finance-os/data/live_plaid_metadata.duckdb` in read-only mode;
13|- `/home/ankit114/projects/personal-finance-os/raw/live/plaid/account_mapping_overrides_v0_2.csv`;
14|- `/home/ankit114/projects/personal-finance-os/exports/analysis/live_plaid_account_inventory_v0_1.csv`;
15|- `/home/ankit114/projects/personal-finance-os/exports/analysis/delta_depository_outflow_rollup_2026-07-31.md`;
16|- `/home/ankit114/projects/personal-finance-os/exports/analysis/delta_depository_outflow_monthly_2026-07-31.csv`;
17|- `/home/ankit114/projects/personal-finance-os/exports/analysis/household_delta_cash_flow_review_2026-07-31.md`;
18|- `/home/ankit114/projects/personal-finance-os/exports/analysis/finance_daily_loop_status.json`.
19|
20|The first three paths are the preferred sources for account mapping and transaction detail. The existing Delta reports are fallback evidence for verified outflows only. Do not treat an outflow-only fallback as sufficient for inflow or net claims.
21|
22|## Task
23|
24|Build a complete Delta-only cash-flow and budgeting analysis from the best verified Finance OS source available.
25|
26|1. Calculate every inbound money source and amount, including source name, category, transaction count, total amount, complete-month average, percentage of total inflow, and monthly amounts.
27|2. Calculate every outbound expense source and amount using the same fields.
28|3. Calculate monthly total inflow, monthly total outflow, monthly net cash flow, average monthly inflow, average monthly outflow, and average monthly net. Annualize only complete-month averages and label the result as a run-rate, never as actual yearly income or spending.
29|4. Produce all three views:
30|   - **Cash-flow view:** monthly inflow, outflow, and net, plus averages and coverage.
31|   - **Category view:** all inflow sources and expense categories/subcategories ranked by dollars, counts, percentage, and monthly average.
32|   - **Line-item view:** every posted transaction with date, direction, amount, merchant/source, category, masked account alias, and classification.
33|5. Break utilities down by utility type and merchant/provider. Include each utility's total, transaction count, monthly average, percentage of utilities, and month-by-month amounts. Do not assume that a combined “Rent and utilities” category contains electric, gas, water, internet, phone, trash, or security unless the source confirms it.
34|6. Identify matched internal transfers, debt payments, investing/retirement contributions, refunds, card-payment settlements, and other non-consumption movements. Show them separately from spending-like expenses and do not double-count card settlements when card purchases are available.
35|7. Give a budgeting interpretation based on observed dollars: recurring/necessary, one-time, flexible, and unclear. Rank potential reduction areas by spending-like dollars. Do not call education, family costs, or services waste without an itemized review.
36|
37|## Constraints
38|
39|- Read-only. Do not move money, pay bills, alter accounts, write to Plaid/QBO/CRM, send messages, or modify external systems.
40|- Never print or store credentials, secrets, raw account numbers, routing numbers, raw Plaid transaction IDs, or sensitive free-form descriptions. Use masked account aliases and safe merchant labels.
41|- Use posted transactions only. Exclude pending transactions and disclose the count excluded.
42|- Remove matched internal transfers from the external net-flow view while retaining a separate transfer schedule.
43|- Do not blend household and business data.
44|- Do not invent missing inflows, categories, merchants, utility types, date coverage, or net results.
45|- Keep raw line-item data in the local CSV deliverable; present aggregates and minimum-necessary detail in the report.
46|- If source access is partial, preserve verified figures, identify the missing direction or period, and mark net as undetermined rather than estimating it.
47|
48|## Output Format
49|
50|Write these files in the current task directory:
51|
52|1. `delta_finance_report.md`
53|   - `# Delta Personal Finance OS Analysis`
54|   - `## Scope and data basis`
55|   - `## Executive summary`
56|   - `## View 1: Cash flow`
57|   - `## View 2: Inflows and expense categories`
58|   - `## View 3: Posted line items`
59|   - `## Utilities breakdown`
60|   - `## Transfers, debt, investing, and card settlements`
61|   - `## Budgeting opportunities`
62|   - `## Unknowns, blockers, and next read-only pull`
63|   - Include compact monthly and ranked tables. State source paths, exact coverage, posted/pending basis, and whether figures are complete or partial.
64|
65|2. `delta_finance_summary.json`
66|   - Required keys: `status`, `scope`, `period_start`, `period_end`, `coverage_status`, `total_inflow`, `total_outflow`, `net_cash_flow`, `average_monthly_inflow`, `average_monthly_outflow`, `average_monthly_net`, `inflow_sources`, `expense_categories`, `utilities`, `monthly`, `line_item_count`, `pending_excluded`, `internal_transfers`, `unknowns`.
67|   - Use `null` for unavailable numeric values and explain them in `unknowns`; never use zero for unmeasured data.
68|
69|3. `delta_finance_line_items.csv`
70|   - Required columns: `date`, `direction`, `amount`, `merchant_or_source`, `category`, `account_alias`, `classification`.
71|   - Include all available posted Delta depository line items in the stated period. Do not include raw transaction IDs or full account identifiers.
72|
73|## Success Criteria
74|
75|- The report clearly says whether the Delta result is complete, partial, or blocked.
76|- Every reported total ties to the CSV line items when line items are available, within one cent.
77|- Monthly totals tie to the summary totals, and inflow minus outflow equals net cash flow.
78|- Inflow and expense sources are both shown, not just a single net number.
79|- All three views are present and materially different: cash flow, category, and line item.
80|- Utilities have a confirmed provider/type breakdown or an explicit statement that the source only supports a combined bucket.
81|- Transfers, debt, investing, card settlements, pending items, and card purchases are not silently double-counted.
82|- No unsupported household net, annual income, merchant, utility, or category claim appears in the report.
83|- The check command must parse the JSON and CSV, recalculate totals, and print a specific reason for any mismatch.
84|
85|## Edge Case Handling
86|
87|- If no Delta inflow data is available, set `status` to `blocked` or `partial`, set unavailable totals to `null`, retain verified outflow figures, and say that net is undetermined.
88|- If only a partial month is available, exclude it from the preferred average and label it in the monthly table.
89|- If an inflow or expense has no merchant or category, use `Unknown source` or `Uncategorized` and include it in `unknowns`; do not infer.
90|- If the same amount appears as opposite-signed transactions between included accounts, flag and remove it from external net flow as an internal transfer.
91|- Treat card-payment settlements as transfers or settlements, not purchases, when card purchase data is also present.
92|- Treat refunds and reversals as separate classifications and show their effect on gross and spending-like totals.
93|- If the local database, statement, or secure connector is unavailable, do not retry indefinitely or use another institution as a substitute. Report the exact blocker and the one safe read-only source needed to finish.
94|

Ringer execution rules: inspect the real local sources before writing. Do not fabricate line items or fill missing amounts with zero. Run a local self-check over the three deliverables before finishing. The report must distinguish verified facts, classification aids, assumptions, and blockers.
